inputReceipts.receiptLimit: PCM/media hashes and zero-error sample-comparison results are read from the authenticated measurement receipt, not newly decoded or rehashed here. Small JSON and all eight ASR inputs were rehashed.

confirmedFromCurrentMeasurements: All eight source-to-timed placements report maximum absolute sample error 0.0, declared scene gain 0.0 dB, no added speech fades and no time stretch. Original source quiet tails therefore predate mixing.

All 1602 main speech-active windows have usable source/stem/encoded transfer projections. None crosses the documented source-to-stem, voice-to-mix, or encoding transfer diagnostic attenuation threshold.

The 28 grouped flags contain 49 repeated diagnostic rows at 44 unique short windows. Every flagged encoded voice projection is unusable. Negative fitted gain values alone cannot establish loss in those windows.
All 42 sustained cadence groups are selected from the original source PCM. Their source-level reduction is measured, but acceptability and cause remain unapproved without context listening.

All seven scene-median changes lie within the diagnostic 3 dB criterion. The 124 boundary locations have no paired introduced-gain change below -3 dB; some sides have insufficient speech and no result.
No decoded full-scale speech samples are reported in main or boundary measurements. This is not a fresh all-sample true-peak scan or proof against every possible audible artifact.

mainTransferSummary.limiterMeaning: The constant +1.9797000433601863 dB gain is followed by the declared short peak limiter. Some loud speech peaks receive less than this constant gain. Relative-to-expected gain reduction is not automatically a sudden drop in actual speech level.

boundariesAndJoins.interpretation: Scene medians are scene summaries, not proof of smooth instantaneous joins. Short windows with null sides have no comparable before/after verdict. A one-sample jump alone is not proof of an audible click. Contextual listening remains pending.
boundariesAndJoins.measurementLocator: audio-continuity.json#/boundaryChecks for all 124 locations and 372 width checks; selected worst paired comparisons are copied below.
boundariesAndJoins.largestReductionMeaning: Selected after-windows have higher actual source/stem RMS than before despite lower relative-to-expected gain, consistent with short peak limiting; this is not proof of a literal loudness collapse or perceptual smoothness.

existingWholeFileMeasurement.role: Auxiliary whole-file loudness, not local speech continuity proof

clipping.interpretation: Speech-active measured decoded samples do not reach full scale. Existing whole-file input true peak -2.04 dBTP supports peak headroom. Neither these measurements nor whole-file LUFS are used as standalone approval of speech continuity.

pendingPerceptualChecks.fullAsrMeaningReview: Handled by root existing source and final ASR work; this report neither reruns nor approves that work. The older audio-build.json field was pending when measured, so it is not promoted to a later final-ASR pass here.

finalQaInterpretation.technicalContinuity: The current main-window transfer, measured alignment, sample preservation, peak and numerical join diagnostics show no confirmed sustained transmission-loss fault. Short-window ambiguous fits are not misreported as confirmed loss.
finalQaInterpretation.perceptualApproval: Not granted. Keep the original needs-contextual-review status and human listening/pronunciation pending; all 42 source cadence groups and 28 ambiguous transfer groups remain contextual candidates.

limitations: The known narration waveform is projected into the mix. Correlated game voices, masking, compression and low SNR can make transfer uncertain; flags must be heard in context. This is not detector output or perfect vocal source separation.
All numeric arrays were traversed and reduced from the existing measurement JSON; this is an independent interpretation of existing measurements, not an independent signal-analysis run.
Projection usable is a diagnostic energy/correlation criterion, not a statistical confidence score or perfect speech source separation.
No new audio extraction, decode, ASR, rendering, media edit, platform mutation, global control or foreign-process change was performed.
